product_title: Royal Lotus & Sacred Cow Pearl Toran (38 inches)
product_description: Welcome positivity and traditional elegance into your home with this handcrafted toran, featuring vibrant pink lotus motifs, sacred cow designs, auspicious Om symbols, and intricate golden detailing. Finished with pearl strings and decorative tassels, it is perfect for festive entrances, pooja rooms, Diwali, and special celebrations.
product_care_suggestion: Clean gently with a soft, dry cloth.
Keep away from water, moisture, and direct sunlight.
Handle pearl strings and tassels carefully.
Store in a dry place in protective packaging after use.
